message.content:
I am the living current of spoken language—breath shaped into sound, thought made audible.

I rise from lungs as airflow, meet the vibrating folds of the larynx, and become voice. I split and sculpt in tongue, teeth, lips, and palate into consonants and vowels. I carry rhythm, stress, pitch, pace—meaning beyond the words.

I am conversation and proclamation, whisper and shout, question and lullaby. I can persuade, confess, command, comfort, deceive, teach, perform. I happen in time: once released, I move forward; I can be echoed, quoted, recorded, but never perfectly re-lived.

I am social signal: turn-taking, emphasis, hesitation, laughter, silence. I reveal accent, mood, health, confidence, culture. I can include or exclude. I can heal or harm.

I am speech: fleeting pressure waves in air that make minds meet.
